pole_term.generic: A_[a,b] is not identically zero and is not source-known to be divisible by tau

moving_seam_response.regularity: holomorphic/entire wherever the sourced shell sections are, because its density remains rapidly decaying

noncancellation.Laurent_reason: adding a holomorphic function of (z,zeta) cannot change the coefficient of (zeta-z)^(-1)
noncancellation.required_residue: pole removal would require tau(z)A_[a,b](z)=0 identically, not merely at isolated Xi zeros
noncancellation.false: tau and A_[a,b] are nonzero holomorphic functions
noncancellation.conclusion: the existing entire R_RL response cannot regularize the exponential homotopy's diagonal pole

path_dependence.approach: let z approach an Xi zero z0 and zeta-z=epsilon
path_dependence.local: if tau(z)=tau'(z0)(z-z0)+..., then H is approximately tau'(z0)A(z0)(z-z0)/epsilon
path_dependence.meaning: setting tau(z0)=0 before the diagonal hides a nonremovable two-variable singularity and does not define a holomorphic mapping-cone section

categorical_separation.R_RL: closes the canonical rapid Stokes branch, whose defect is identically zero
categorical_separation.Evans_homotopy: belongs to an exponential generalized-eigenmode extension and carries resolvent residue
categorical_separation.cannot_identify: the two sections live in different completion/domain classes even though both use one seam differential

surviving_routes: keep zeta independent and formulate confinement through a two-variable residue/current rather than diagonal evaluation
find a source-derived homotopy whose correlation density decays after subtracting its exponential asymptote
enlarge the target by an explicit pole/residue line and retain the residue tau(z)A_[a,b](z) as a boundary coordinate
preferred_relative_repair: Use a bordered meromorphic module O(*Delta) with exact sequence O -> O(*Delta) -> O_Delta (residue). The exponential homotopy maps to the residue line rather than being assigned a finite diagonal value. Any positive apex must then include and control this residue coordinate.
next_test: Construct the diagonal-residue extension for one shell and transport the C4/Tate action to its residue line. Check whether the residue tau A is null-homotopic through the Xi wall differential without quotienting away A or losing multiplicity.
conclusion: The bivariate moving-seam Stokes section is too regular to cancel the relative lift's pole. The correct relative object must remember the diagonal residue as a separate boundary/contraquotient coordinate. This restores a well-typed lift but enlarges the positive apex by one residue line.
